mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_report (bld_id, user_id, title, format, period_from, period_to, record_cnt, file_name, content) VALUES (#{bldId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{format}, #{periodFrom}, #{periodTo}, #{recordCnt}, #{fileName}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, bld_id, user_id, title, format, file_name FROM ai_report WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
